definitions.name: G1B.MIN
definitions.body: 'G1B.R' BIND G1B.R G1B.R 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1B.RANGE
definitions.note: max minus min of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1B.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G1B.N' BIND G1B.N G1B.N G1B.MIN - G1B.N G1B.RANGE /
definitions.note: rescale each number to (x - min) / (max - min)

definitions.name: G1B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'G1B.C' BIND G1B.C 0 G1B.C 0 GET UPPER PUT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

definitions.name: G1B.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ CHARS REVERSE [ ' ' ] CONCAT REVERSE ] MAP FLATTEN [ 1 ] DROP JOIN
definitions.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: G1B.TITLECASE
definitions.note: capitalize every word of a space-separated String

definitions.name: G1B.LONGEST
definitions.note: character count of the longest word in a space-separated String

definitions.name: G1B.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word, as one String
